label: item from item, property, and object role
description: Among the item's statements for the given property, selects the best-ranked one whose 'object of statement has role' (P3831) qualifier equals the given role item, and returns that statement's value as a Wikidata item reference. Use it when a property has several values distinguished by role, e.g. the svara items' 'said to be the same as' (P460) statements to a note name and to a scale degree (role Q586277 degree). Generalises Z31108.
summary: New function: item from item, property, and object role
